sources.title: flan-t5-small: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: Overview flan-t5-small is a text-to-text transformer model maintained by google that performs instruction-following tasks across 1000+ diverse NLP jobs. Built on the T5 architecture and fine-tuned on instruction data, this model handles translation, summarization, question answering, reasoning, and classification without task-specific training. sources.snippet: We also publicly release Flan-T5 checkpoints,1 which achieve strong few-shot performance even compared to much larger models, such as PaLM 62B. Overall, instruction finetuning is a general method for improving the performance and usability of pretrained language models.

sources.title: FLAN-T5 - llmmodels.org
sources.snippet: FLAN-T5 is an enhanced iteration of Google's widely used T5 model, refined through a process known as instruct-finetuning. This technique involves training the model on specific instructions, allowing it to better understand and execute tasks in accordance with those instructions.
